title: Ore Choir
summary: Start: enter Ore Choir. The log opens the job and the helm marks the rim pocket. Do: enter the claim jumper's sight, 400 meters of the rim pocket. The jumper sits that pocket and chases a keel that enters it. A kite holds the belt flank. The Choir Hauler orbits the anvil. Finish: after the pocket is seen, come inside Choir Anvil's shell. The Charter writes standing. The belt is a lease, not a gift. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
